Git Simple Compare: GitHub Git Proactive Auth
Use existing Git credentials before a GitHub.com HTTPS authentication challenge. Applies only to proven compatible native Git operations and respects explicit authentication settings. May require credentials for public repositories that previously allowed anonymous access.

Git Simple Compare: GitHub Read Transport
GitHub read transport. Auto reuses HTTPS connections after repository verification when network policy is supported. Proxy, custom CA and unsupported hosts use GitHub CLI. Changing this cancels active reads.

Git Simple Compare: Clone Mode
Clone mode for new repositories. Blobless keeps all commits, branches and current files, then downloads older file contents when needed. It requires Git 2.46+ and verified native Git access; otherwise Full is used.
